h1: Insulation Contractor in Castro Valley, CA
description: Insulation contractor in Castro Valley, CA for hillside homes on piers and their crawl spaces, 6 miles east of our San Leandro base. Book a free inspection.
intro: East Bay Insulation serves Castro Valley from our San Leandro base, about 6 miles east via I-580. Many of the town's hillside homes sit on piers, which puts the crawl space and the floor above it at the center of most jobs we do there.

sections.h2: Homes on piers need a different plan
paragraphs: A home on piers has open air under the floor, and on a hillside that can mean cold floors, drafts and damp moving through the crawl space. We inspect the structure first, then plan the insulation and vapor barrier around how the house sits on its lot.
We also look at the attics above those hillside homes, where summer heat collects and winter heat escapes.

sections.h2: Services Castro Valley asks for most
bullets: Crawl space insulation and encapsulation under pier foundations

faqs.q: How quickly can you get to Castro Valley?
faqs.a: We are about 6 miles away in San Leandro via I-580, so inspections are usually scheduled within the same week.

faqs.q: Can you insulate a crawl space under a home on piers?
faqs.a: Yes. Pier foundations are common in Castro Valley, and sealing and insulating those crawl spaces is a regular part of our work there.

faqs.q: Do you inspect hillside lots differently?
faqs.a: We check the crawl space, the floor assembly and the attic together, because hillside homes often lose heat through all three. The inspection is free and comes with a written estimate.
